title: 09 · Quarry: project workspace (desktop, 1440×900 @2x)
strengths: Card density, label chips, initials avatars and the sidebar sections match Linear and Height at a real 14/12 px scale; one vermilion for today, urgent, due dates and the primary action.
Believable work: FLD-231 'Bulk reassign jobs from the dispatcher map', 'Retry queue for failed photo uploads', a 'Release 4.2' milestone on Fri 17, 'Synced 2 s ago', a named engineering lead.
Own details inside the convention: diamond status glyphs, keyboard numbers on the view tabs, a 3/5 subtask bar on the focused card.
slop_signals: A two-week timeline and a five-column board stacked on one screen: Linear and Jira show one or the other, so the composite reads as a showcase, not a view someone works in.
A permanent keyboard-shortcut footer across the bottom; real tools keep this behind '?'.
Every label chip repeats the same diamond glyph before its text.
fixes: Show either the board or the timeline; if both, collapse the timeline to a one-row cycle-progress strip.
Remove the shortcut footer, or reduce it to 'Synced 2 s ago' and a '?'.
Drop the glyph from label chips, or give each label its own colour dot as Linear does.

references.what: Board with id, title, label dots and avatar per card, sidebar in sections: the anatomy this piece reproduces, with no timeline above it.
Milestone progress lives in a side panel, not in a strip over the board.
Dark board, same card anatomy; no shortcut footer.
